descripcion_html:
Core Skills
  • 4+ years in SEO with measurable wins you can walk us through
  • Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, indexing, structured data, Core Web Vitals
  • Experience with programmatic SEO or content at scale
  • Real AI-search work you can show us: content that earned citations, experiments you ran, visibility you moved
  • Fluent with the standard stack: Semrush or Ahrefs, Search Console, GA4 or Amplitude, WordPress
Mindset
  • Ownership-driven: you treat the channel like it's your business
  • Experimental: AI search has no playbook yet, and that excites you
  • Pragmatic with data: you ship, measure, and iterate
  • Strong communicator who can explain what's working and why
  • Don't tick every box? If the core skills fit and you've done real work in this space, apply anyway. We care more about what you've shipped than a perfect checklist.
About Influencers.club
Influencers.club is the data layer of the creator economy. We help some of the world's biggest brands and fastest-growing startups turn creator data into real business results. Today, 600+ companies run on our data, including Amazon, L'Oréal, HP, AliExpress, Airbnb, and Perplexity. We build the APIs and data products that make creator data actually useful, powering discovery, enrichment, and analytics inside CRMs, growth systems, and AI workflows around the world.
The Role
We're looking for an SEO & AI Search Manager to own how people and AI models find Influencers.club. Our site already brings in 150,000+ organic visits a month. Your job is to grow that number, and to win the channel that's replacing search as we know it: making Influencers.club the creator data source that ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews cite and recommend.
Own Organic Growth
Own SEO strategy and execution end to end: technical, content, and off-page
Grow 150k monthly organic visits into a compounding acquisition channel that drives signups and revenue
Build and own the measurement framework and its live dashboard: rankings, AI citations, share of voice, and organic signups. This becomes how the whole company sees the channel
Win AI Search
Grow our visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews through entity coverage, structured data, answer-level content, and everything LLMs read about us
Track how AI models cite and recommend us, with tools like Profound or Peec, or by building our own (we have the engineering support to do it)
Run our digital PR motion: reviews, roundups, and data studies that earn the citations LLMs trust
Work with a rare advantage: our data already powers AI workflows through our API and MCP integrations, so you're marketing a product AI assistants actually use
Scale Programmatic SEO
Run and expand our programmatic page engine: hundreds of pages across niches, geographies, and rankings
Launch and promote free tools built to earn links, mentions, and traffic
Turn our proprietary creator data into content and studies nobody else can publish
Work Across Teams
  • Partner closely with growth and engineering to ship fast
  • Use AI tools and agents daily. We build with them, and expect you to as well
  • Bring the outside in: what's changing in search, and what we should do about it
  • B2B SaaS background, ideally data products or APIs
  • Digital PR and link-earning experience
  • Basic HTML/CSS and enough technical comfort to work directly with engineers
  • Experience building workflows with AI tools and agents
  • A running start: 150k+ monthly visits, a live programmatic engine, and free tools already earning links
  • A data moat: proprietary creator data means you can publish studies and pages competitors simply can't
  • Full channel ownership: your strategy, your roadmap, your results
  • The frontier of search: own AI/LLM visibility at a company whose product is built for the AI era
  • An AI-forward team: modern tools and workflows are the default here
  • Flexible remote setup built around trust and autonomy
  • Fast growth opportunities inside a scaling startup
